tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low pO₂, low O₂ saturation), with mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. These findings may indicate acute respiratory failure with possible underlying infection or inflammation and bone marrow suppression. Other parameters, including renal, liver, and metabolic markers, are within normal limits. Immediate clinical assessment and intervention are recommended.
